summary: The comment expresses opposition to discontinuing the E-Rate program, citing concerns about the financial burden on libraries and the potential for budget cuts if funding is cut. The comment highlights the importance of the program for libraries to provide internet access and services to patrons and staff.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate, libraries will face budget cuts
claims.evidence_quote: Without this program, the financial burden will fall on our municipalities, whose budgets are already stretched incredibly thin.
